# metabase_snippet (Resource)

A native query snippet: a reusable SQL fragment referenced from native queries as `{{snippet: name}}`.

The Metabase API cannot delete snippets, only archive them: destroying this resource archives the snippet, and an archived snippet still holds its (instance-unique) name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "metabase_snippet" "valid_receipts" {
  name        = "Valid receipts"
  description = "Shared WHERE clause selecting non-test, non-cancelled receipts."
  content     = <<-EOT
    WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
    AND state != 'Cancelled'
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) The SQL fragment.
- `name` (String) The name of the snippet, unique across the instance.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the snippet.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the snippet.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Use the integer ID from the Metabase API.
terraform import metabase_snippet.snippet 1
```
